prs_waiting_for_sail.name: PRs Waiting for SAIL
prs_waiting_for_sail.description: Pull requests currently waiting on SAIL (the sail check), counted at any moment.
prs_waiting_for_sail.note: Create a stock called PRs Waiting for SAIL.

options.title: Open PRs labelled SAIL on GitHub
options.how: Count the open pull requests of danroblewis/orchestra-live-delivery that carry the label SAIL and not SAILED, at each round.
options.cost: One GitHub API listing per round; well inside GitHub's rate limit at a 60s interval.
options.caveat: Counts only the repository named; a PR whose label was removed without a SAILED label is counted until the next round.

options.title: Count SAIL labels minus SAILED and merges from the event stream
options.how: Read the local events: count github.pr.labeled with label SAIL, less those later labelled SAILED or merged, per pull request.
options.cost: Reads the local event store only; a round is a few seconds.
options.caveat: A derived count from events, not a live read of GitHub; it is right only while every label change reaches the bus.

github.title: github
github.description: Named by workflow delivery_live: the outside system github, known by the actors its bridge relays.

steps: delivery_live · open_pr: outside github; done when github.pr.opened; done → ci; on github.pr.synchronize → ci; guard within 1200 s, then attention
delivery_live · ci: outside github; done when github.checks.completed with head_sha = the item's commit; success → review, failure → write; guard within 1800 s, then attention

delivery_live · review: outside github; done when github.pr.reviewed with state = setting review_state; done → sail; on github.pr.reviewed with state = "changes_requested" → write; guard within 1800 s, then attention

delivery_live · sail_check: outside github; done when github.pr.labeled with label = "SAILED"; done → close_ticket; on github.pr.labeled with label = "REJECTED" → triage; guard at most 3 rounds, then attention
spec.source: bot.github, bot.github.<login> and person.github.<login> (relayed by its bridge)

review_nudger.title: Review Nudger
review_nudger.description: When a pull request has waited too long for its review or for SAIL, remind the reviewer.

invariants: Never approves, merges, labels or closes a pull request.
Never changes code; it proposes a reminder only.
A reminder goes out only through the outbox for the owner's approval.
A pull request counts as waiting only while it has no merge and its latest SAIL result is not a pass.
steps: 1. At each run, read github.pr.opened, github.pr.reviewed, github.pr.labeled and github.pr.merged to find open pull requests and when each began waiting for review.
2. Read sail.check.completed to find pull requests waiting on SAIL and how long.
3. For each pull request waiting longer than the threshold the owner sets, propose a reminder to its reviewer through the outbox.
uses: the pull request and SAIL events on the bus (read only)

provenance.author: owner
provenance.message: Create a machine called Review Nudger: when a pull request has waited too long for its review or for SAIL, it reminds the reviewer. It should listen for the GitHub pull request events and the SAIL check results on the bus. Make it a scheduled task for 9am every day. Then confirm it. I expect SAILED per day ×1.2.
provenance.quote: Create a machine called Review Nudger
provenance.reason: The owner wants stale pull requests waiting on review or SAIL nudged once a day at 9am.
